title: Karmada 毕业与 Kubernetes 上 AI 训练、推理平台化
english: CNCF announced Karmada’s graduation, describing the project as a production-mature platform for multi-cluster and multi-cloud Kubernetes orchestration. The announcement comes as enterprises scale AI training and inference across hybrid infrastructure. Related CNCF announcements highlight a broader shift toward inference: China Merchants Bank reported that its cloud native platform unified AI training and inference on Kubernetes, raising average accelerator utilization from 35% to more than 60% and reducing inference cost per one million tokens by more than 60%. CNCF and SlashData also reported that 48% of China’s IIoT developers use cloud native technologies, compared with a 42% global average.
chinese: CNCF 将 Karmada 提升至毕业项目，表明多集群、多云 Kubernetes 编排已具备生产成熟度。同期案例显示，企业正在把 AI 训练与推理统一到 Kubernetes 平台：招商银行的云原生平台提升了平均加速器利用率，并降低了按百万 token 计的推理成本。行业信号并非只关注模型训练，而是转向可持续运营、资源调度和成本可控的推理基础设施。
why_it_matters: 对云原生和 AIOps 团队而言，多集群调度、混合基础设施治理、GPU/加速器利用率与推理单位成本正在成为关键运营指标。对 Agent Infra 而言，稳定且可扩展的推理承载平台是部署和运营 Agent 工作负载的基础。职业上，应加强 Kubernetes 多集群编排、容量管理、可观测性及 AI 推理成本治理能力。
interview_expression: I focus on operating AI platforms as production systems, including multi-cluster orchestration, accelerator utilization, and inference cost. I would measure success through service reliability, resource efficiency, and unit economics rather than model deployment alone.

vocabulary.meaning: 编排；协调多个系统或资源的运行
vocabulary.example: Multi-cluster orchestration can help teams manage workloads across hybrid infrastructure.

vocabulary.meaning: 推理；模型根据输入生成结果的过程
vocabulary.example: Inference workloads require predictable capacity and cost controls.

vocabulary.meaning: 加速器利用率，通常指 GPU 等计算加速资源的使用效率
vocabulary.example: The platform increased average accelerator utilization to more than 60%.
